answer: One practical brake is a time-gated work voyage: the protocol issues a unique task every few minutes, and an identity may vote only after finishing a long enough chain of those tasks itself. Because each step is personalized and expires quickly, a farm cannot photocopy one completed path onto many aliases. If the activity pulse of an account stops mid-sequence, unfinished credit lapses, and any leftover proof becomes a relic that cannot be transferred or replayed.
